title: objectql: an objectExtensions entry on a better-auth-managed object (sys_organization) gets system columns injected (organization_id NULL on every row), and the tenant wall then hides every organisation from its own owner and members
body:
Filing gate ①: class (a), a public door answering wrong, measured. Filed by `repo:cloud#2` (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#24145, session `session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX`) from the cloud#3014 dev report. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens (booted cloud control plane, framework pin `be076dad28a0`)

A package registers an `objectExtensions` entry on `sys_organization`. In the measurement, cloud's `service-tenant` manifest added one `summary` field. Then:
- **owner:** `GET /api/v1/data/sys_organization?limit=50` answers 200 with `records: []`;
- **plain member** (after `set-active` 200): the same list answers `[]`, and `GET /api/v1/data/sys_organization/ORG_ID` answers **404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND** on their own organisation;
- **control, without the extension:** the owner and the member read their own row with 200, and a member's read of another org is 404, so the org-scope wall holds.

## Why

- **`ObjectRegistry.registerObject`** (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts:3088`) runs `applySystemFields` on the **extension body**.
- **The injected-columns plan** (`packages/spec/src/data/injected-system-columns.ts:206`) skips only a body that itself says `managedBy: 'better-auth'`, and an extension body carries no `managedBy`.
- **So the merged `sys_organization`** (a better-auth table) gains `organization_id`, `created_by` and `updated_by`, physically too. `organization_id` is NULL on every row, and the tenant wall bounds the table by it.
- **The same file's rule says** better-auth tables get no injected columns because "extra columns would collide".
- **Also measured:** `sys_organization` declares protection lock `full` ("no safe extension point at all", `shared/protection.zod.ts:165-170`), but the lock is enforced only on metadata save / delete, not on package extensions. Either refuse the extension loudly, or merge it without injection.

`sys_user` is in the same family; not measured.

## Wanted (the lane picks)

- An extension body inherits its target's injection plan: no system columns on a better-auth-managed target.
- **Or** an extension of a `lock: 'full'` object is refused at registration, with an error naming the lock. Declared is enforced, and the refusal is loud.
- A test on a booted multi-tenant kernel: the extension registered, and the owner and the member still read their organisation.

Dedupe words: objectExtensions, applySystemFields extension body, injected system columns better-auth, managedBy extension, protection lock full extension.
